headline: 93°F returns — Phoenix harvest opens Aug 24, dig overdue.
weather_notes: Water all zones Wednesday morning — zones ran Sunday and 93°F daily heat exhausts soil moisture within 2 days.
Pick any ripe blackberries by Tuesday morning — 93°F Mon–Wed will bake remaining Triple Crown fruit on the cane.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds by 11 AM daily — sustained 93°F through Wednesday puts developing Phoenix fruit at sunscald risk with harvest opening Aug 24.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 38 days overdue — early morning before 9 AM is the only safe window under returning 93°F heat this week.

suggested_tasks.title: Harvest w4 onions — 114 days, past maturity
suggested_tasks.description: Super Star and Yellow Sweet Spanish at 114 days are past their maturity window — pull bulbs before 93°F accelerates neck rot in now-dry soil.

suggested_tasks.title: Dig potato bags — 10 days past harvest window
suggested_tasks.description: Yukon Gold at 90 days is 10 past the 80-day outer window — dig at least one bag before continued 93°F heat accelerates vine decline.

suggested_tasks.title: Check e1 Phoenix for first fruit
suggested_tasks.description: Harvest window opens Aug 24 — verify fruit is setting and cage support is solid 7 days before first pick.
